verdict: Strong 28-day return, but last week's purchase spike was a single day.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.98 for every $1.00 spent across $1,483.81 in ad spend — a healthy result. However, the 33% week-over-week purchase jump and the 56% return-on-spend surge are both driven almost entirely by one strong day on August 11; the daily purchase rate on surrounding days was near zero, so the spike should be read as a cluster rather than a trend shift. Instagram reach has dipped roughly 28% from mid-July levels while spend held steady, an early sign the current creative is losing its pull, so new ad creative is being introduced this week. The live-cooking shoot on August 14 will feed fresh content into the rotation, and you should expect steadier, less clustered purchase activity as that material runs.
